canonical_name: No Leadership Accountability for Cybersecurity Risk
description: Organizational leadership is not accountable for cybersecurity risk.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Identify organizations where executive leadership has not formally accepted accountability for cybersecurity risk management, lacks documented cybersecurity responsibilities in role descriptions, or does not demonstrate active engagement in cybersecurity governance activities.
